reasoning: NPL 1.1 Amendment IV permits Netscape to reintegrate specified third-party code into Covered Code without distributing that code in source form, even if it would otherwise qualify as a Modification. Netscape must have licensed it for use in its Branded Code before licensing Original Code under this license, and the exception extends only as far as the contractual limit.
